source.text: וַיְהִ֣י הַיּ֔וֹם וַיָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים לְהִתְיַצֵּ֖ב עַל־יְהוָ֑ה וַיָּב֤וֹא גַֽם־הַשָּׂטָן֙ בְּתֹכָ֔ם לְהִתְיַצֵּ֖ב עַל־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was the day, and came [the] sons of God to present themselves before YHWH, and came also the satan in their midst to present himself before YHWH.

en.L: And the day came when the sons of God came to present themselves before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and the satan also came among them to present himself before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: On another day the sons of God came to present themselves before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and the Accuser also came among them to present himself before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: On another day the heavenly beings came to stand before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and the Accuser came with them to stand before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} too.

es.L: Y llegó el día en que los hijos de Dios vinieron a presentarse delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y vino también el satán entre ellos a presentarse delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Otro día los hijos de Dios vinieron a presentarse ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y también el Acusador vino entre ellos a presentarse ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Otro día los seres celestiales vinieron a presentarse delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y el Acusador también vino con ellos a presentarse delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et le jour arriva où les fils de Dieu vinrent se présenter devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et le satan vint aussi parmi eux se présenter devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Un autre jour, les fils de Dieu vinrent se présenter devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et l’Accusateur vint lui aussi au milieu d’eux se présenter devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Un autre jour, les êtres célestes sont venus se tenir devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et l’Accusateur est venu avec eux pour se tenir lui aussi devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na ikawa siku moja, wana wa Mungu walikuja kujisimamisha mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, naye yule satani akaja pia kati yao kujisimamisha mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Siku nyingine wana wa Mungu walikuja kusimama mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na Mshtaki naye akaja pamoja nao kusimama mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Siku nyingine viumbe wa mbinguni walifika mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na Mshtaki naye akaja pamoja nao kusimama mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Và đến ngày kia, các con trai của Đức Chúa Trời đến trình diện trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và kẻ sa-tan cũng đến giữa họ để trình diện trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Một ngày khác, các con trai của Đức Chúa Trời lại đến trình diện trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và Kẻ Tố Cáo cũng đến giữa họ để trình diện trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Một ngày khác, các đấng ở trên trời đến đứng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và Kẻ Tố Cáo cũng đến với họ để đứng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그날이 되어, 하나님의 아들들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 나아와 서려고 왔고, 그 사탄도 그들 가운데 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 나아와 서려고 왔다.
ko.B: 또 어느 날 하나님의 아들들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 나아와 자기 자리에 섰다. 고발자도 그들 가운데 함께 와서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 섰다.
ko.R: 또 어느 날 하늘의 존재들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 와서 섰다. 고발자도 그들과 함께 와서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 섰다.

pt.L: E chegou o dia em que os filhos de Deus vieram se apresentar diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e veio também o Satanás entre eles para se apresentar diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Em outro dia, os filhos de Deus vieram se apresentar diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e o acusador também veio no meio deles para se apresentar diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Em outro dia, os seres celestiais vieram se apresentar diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e o acusador também veio com eles para se apresentar diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

am.L: ቀኑም በደረሰ ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት ሊቆሙ መጡ፤ ሰይጣኑም ደግሞ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት ሊቆም በመካከላቸው መጣ።
am.B: በሌላ ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ልጆች {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት ለመቆም መጡ፤ ከሳሹም ደግሞ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት ለመቆም ከእነርሱ ጋር መጣ።
am.R: በሌላ ቀን የሰማይ ፍጡራን {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት ለመቆም መጡ፤ ከሳሹም {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት ለመቆም ከእነርሱ ጋር መጣ።

hi.L: और वह दिन आया जब परमेश्वर के पुत्र {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सामने उपस्थित होने आए, और शैतान भी उनके बीच {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सामने उपस्थित होने आया।
hi.B: एक और दिन परमेश्वर के पुत्र {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सामने उपस्थित होने आए, और दोष लगानेवाला भी उनके बीच {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सामने उपस्थित होने आया।
hi.R: एक और दिन स्वर्गीय प्राणी {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सामने खड़े होने आए, और दोष लगानेवाला भी उनके साथ {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सामने खड़ा होने आया।

ru.L: И был день, и пришли сыны Божьи предстать перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}; и пришёл также сатана среди них предстать перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}.
ru.B: В другой день сыны Божьи пришли предстать перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, и Обвинитель тоже пришёл вместе с ними предстать перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: В другой день небесные существа пришли встать перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, и Обвинитель тоже пришёл вместе с ними, чтобы встать перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: そしてその日のこと、神の子らが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前に出るために来た。そしてサタンもまた、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前に出るために、彼らの中に来た。
ja.B: また別の日に、神の子らが来て{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前に進み出ると、告発する者もまた彼らの中に来て、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前に進み出た。
ja.R: また別の日に、天にいる者たちが、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前に出て来ました。すると、告発する者も一緒に来て、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前に立ちました。

uk.L: І настав день, і прийшли сини Божі стати перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, і прийшов також сатана серед них стати перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Іншого дня сини Божі прийшли стати перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, і серед них прийшов також Обвинувач, щоб стати перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: Іншого дня небесні істоти прийшли стати перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}, і з ними прийшов Обвинувач, щоб теж стати перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Ягве}}.

decisions.choice: the scene of 1:6 repeated, with one addition
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 1:6 word for word and adds that the satan too came "to present himself before the LORD". This time he comes, like the others, to give his report, and the reader expects him to answer for the outcome of the first test.

decisions.choice: the sons of God; the satan: as at 1:6
decisions.reason: The sons of God are the heavenly beings of God's council, and "the satan" is a title, the accuser or adversary in the heavenly court; see the notes at 1:6.

decisions.choice: the satan (Literal), the Accuser (Balanced, Readable); the heavenly beings (Readable)
decisions.reason: As at 1:6. Balanced and Readable say "on another day" because this is a second scene of the same kind; Literal keeps "the day came".

decisions.choice: Narrative tenses: passé simple at Literal and Balanced, passé composé at Readable
decisions.reason: As in chapter 1: the prose of Job 1-2 uses the literary narrative tense at Literal and Balanced and the spoken past tense at Readable.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Job 2.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic. The satan and the sons of God keep the wording of 1:6 (L "ሰይጣኑ", B, R "ከሳሹ").

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change in Hindi; respect for God comes from तू in address and the honorific third person. This holds for the whole file.

decisions.choice: "शैतान" (Literal), "दोष लगानेवाला" (Balanced, Readable); "परमेश्वर के पुत्र" (Literal, Balanced), "स्वर्गीय प्राणी" (Readable)
decisions.reason: As at 1:6. Balanced and Readable say "एक और दिन" for the second scene of the same kind, as the English does.

decisions.choice: сатана (L), Обвинитель (B, R); сыны Божьи (L, B), небесные существа (R)
decisions.reason: As at 1:6: "the satan" is a title, the accuser in God's court, and the sons of God are heavenly beings. The scene repeats 1:6 word for word, so the Russian does too.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־הַשָּׂטָ֔ן אֵ֥י מִזֶּ֖ה תָּבֹ֑א וַיַּ֨עַן הַשָּׂטָ֤ן אֶת־יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר מִשֻּׁ֣ט בָּאָ֔רֶץ וּמֵהִתְהַלֵּ֖ךְ בָּֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said YHWH to the satan, where [is] this, from where do you come? And answered the satan YHWH and said, from roaming on the earth and from walking about on it.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to the satan, "Where is it you come from?" And the satan answered {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and said, "From roaming on the earth, and from walking about on it."
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to the Accuser, "Where have you come from?" The Accuser answered {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "From roaming the earth and walking up and down on it."
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} asked the Accuser, "Where have you been?" The Accuser answered, "I have been going all over the earth, walking back and forth across it."

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo al satán: «¿De dónde, pues, vienes?». Y el satán respondió {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y dijo: «De rondar por la tierra y de andar de un lado a otro por ella».
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo al Acusador: «¿De dónde has venido?». El Acusador respondió {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «De recorrer la tierra y andar de aquí para allá por ella».
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le preguntó al Acusador: «¿Dónde has estado?». El Acusador respondió: «He estado recorriendo toda la tierra, yendo de un lado a otro».

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit au satan : « D’où donc viens-tu ? » Et le satan répondit {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} et dit : « De rôder sur la terre et d’y circuler. »
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à l’Accusateur : « D’où viens-tu ? » L’Accusateur répondit {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : « De rôder sur la terre et d’y aller et venir. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a demandé à l’Accusateur : « Où étais-tu ? » L’Accusateur a répondu : « J’ai parcouru toute la terre, j’y suis allé de long en large. »

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia yule satani, "Je, unatoka wapi basi?" Naye yule satani akamjibu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akasema, "Kutoka kuranda-randa duniani, na kutembea-tembea juu yake."
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Mshtaki, "Umetoka wapi?" Mshtaki akamjibu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "Nimekuwa nikizurura duniani na kutembea juu na chini ndani yake."
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwuliza Mshtaki, "Ulikuwa wapi?" Mshtaki akajibu, "Nimekuwa nikizunguka dunia yote, nikitembea huku na kule."

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với kẻ sa-tan: "Ngươi từ đâu mà đến?" Và kẻ sa-tan thưa với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} rằng: "Từ việc lang thang trên đất và đi lại trên đó."
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán hỏi Kẻ Tố Cáo: "Ngươi từ đâu đến?" Kẻ Tố Cáo thưa với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Tôi vừa rong ruổi khắp đất và đi tới đi lui trên đó."
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hỏi Kẻ Tố Cáo: "Ngươi đã ở đâu?" Kẻ Tố Cáo thưa: "Tôi đã đi khắp mặt đất, đi tới đi lui khắp nơi."

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그 사탄에게 말씀하셨다. "너는 대체 어디에서 오느냐?" 그러자 그 사탄이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 대답하여 말했다. "땅 위를 두루 다니다가, 그 위를 거닐다가 왔습니다."
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 고발자에게 물으셨다. "어디에서 왔느냐?" 고발자가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 대답했다. "땅을 두루 돌아다니며 이리저리 거닐다가 왔습니다."
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 고발자에게 물으셨다. "어디에 있다 왔느냐?" 고발자가 대답했다. "온 땅을 돌아다녔습니다. 이곳저곳을 오가며 다녔습니다."

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse ao Satanás: "De onde é que vens?" E o Satanás respondeu {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} e disse: "De percorrer a terra e de andar por ela."
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} perguntou ao acusador: "De onde vens?" O acusador respondeu {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}: "De percorrer a terra, andando por ela de um lado para o outro."
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} perguntou ao acusador: "Por onde andaste?" O acusador respondeu: "Estive andando pela terra toda, indo e vindo por ela."

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም ሰይጣኑን፦ «ከወዴት ነው የመጣኸው?» አለው። ሰይጣኑም {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} መልሶ፦ «በምድር ላይ ከመዘዋወርና በእርሷ ላይ ከመመላለስ [መጣሁ]» አለ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከሳሹን፦ «ከየት መጣህ?» አለው። ከሳሹም {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}}፦ «በምድር ዙሪያ ከመዞርና በእርሷ ላይ ወዲያና ወዲህ ከመመላለስ» ብሎ መለሰ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከሳሹን፦ «የት ነበርክ?» ብሎ ጠየቀው። ከሳሹም፦ «ምድርን ሁሉ ስዞር ነበር፤ በእርሷ ላይ ወዲያና ወዲህ ስመላለስ ነበር» ብሎ መለሰ።

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने शैतान से कहा, "तुम आते कहाँ से हो?" और शैतान ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को उत्तर देकर कहा, "पृथ्वी पर इधर-उधर घूमने से, और उस पर चलने-फिरने से।"
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने दोष लगानेवाले से कहा, "तुम कहाँ से आए हो?" दोष लगानेवाले ने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} को उत्तर दिया, "पृथ्वी पर इधर-उधर घूमते और उस पर आते-जाते हुए।"
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने दोष लगानेवाले से पूछा, "तुम कहाँ थे?" दोष लगानेवाले ने उत्तर दिया, "मैं सारी पृथ्वी पर घूम रहा था, उस पर इधर से उधर आ-जा रहा था।"

ru.L: И сказал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сатане: «Откуда же ты пришёл?» И ответил сатана {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} и сказал: «Я обходил землю и ходил по ней.»
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал Обвинителю: «Откуда ты пришёл?» Обвинитель ответил {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}: «Я бродил по земле и обошёл её вдоль и поперёк.»
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} спросил Обвинителя: «Где ты был?» Обвинитель ответил: «Я ходил по всей земле, обходил её из края в край.»

ja.L: そして{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はサタンに言われた。「おまえはいったいどこから来たのか？」サタンは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に答えて言った。「地を行き巡り、その上を歩き回って[来ました]。」
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告発する者に言われた。「おまえはどこから来たのか？」告発する者は{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に答えた。「地を行き巡り、あちこちを歩き回って来ました。」
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告発する者に、「おまえはどこへ行っていたのか？」と尋ねられました。告発する者は答えました。「地上をあちこち回って、行ったり来たりしていました。」

uk.L: І сказав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сатані: «Звідки це ти приходиш?» І відповів сатана {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} й сказав: «Із блукання по землі й ходіння по ній».
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} спитав Обвинувача: «Звідки ти прийшов?» Обвинувач відповів {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}}: «Я обходив землю й ходив по ній туди й сюди».
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} спитав Обвинувача: «Де ти був?» Обвинувач відповів: «Я ходив по всій землі, проходжуючись нею туди й назад».

decisions.choice: where from?: a slightly different question from 1:7, with the same sense
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses a different pair of words for "from where" than in 1:7 (as in Genesis 16:8), but the question is the same. The satan's answer is word for word that of 1:7; see the note there on roaming the earth.

decisions.choice: Where is it you come from? (Literal)
decisions.reason: Literal shows that the wording differs a little from 1:7; Balanced and Readable give the same English as there because the meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: "तुम आते कहाँ से हो?" (Literal)
decisions.reason: Literal shows that the question is worded a little differently from 1:7; Balanced and Readable repeat the Hindi of 1:7 because the sense is the same, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Откуда же ты пришёл? (L)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew question differs slightly from 1:7 (m1); Literal marks the difference with "же", as the English Literal does with "Where is it", and Balanced and Readable repeat 1:7.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־הַשָּׂטָ֗ן הֲשַׂ֣מְתָּ לִבְּךָ֮ אֶל־עַבְדִּ֣י אִיּוֹב֒ כִּי֩ אֵ֨ין כָּמֹ֜הוּ בָּאָ֗רֶץ אִ֣ישׁ תָּ֧ם וְיָשָׁ֛ר יְרֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים וְסָ֣ר מֵרָ֑ע וְעֹדֶ֨נּוּ֙ מַחֲזִ֣יק בְּתֻמָּת֔וֹ וַתְּסִיתֵ֥נִי ב֖וֹ לְבַלְּע֥וֹ חִנָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And said YHWH to the satan, have you set your heart on my servant Job? For there is none like him on the earth, a man blameless and upright, fearing God and turning aside from evil; and still he [is] holding fast to his integrity, and you incited me against him to swallow him up for nothing.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to the satan, "Have you set your heart on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} slave Job? For there is none like him on the earth, a man blameless and upright, who fears God and turns away from evil. And he still holds fast to his integrity, though you incited {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} against him to swallow him up for nothing."
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to the Accuser, "Have you considered {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant Job? There is no one like him on earth: a man blameless and upright, who fears God and turns away from evil. He still holds firmly to his integrity, even though you stirred {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} up against him to destroy him for no reason."
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to the Accuser, "Have you noticed {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} servant Job? There is no one on earth like him. He is blameless and upright. He honors God and keeps away from evil. You urged {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to act against him and ruin him for no reason, but he still holds on to his integrity."

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo al satán: «¿Has puesto tu corazón en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} esclavo Job? Porque no hay nadie como él en la tierra, hombre íntegro y recto, que teme a Dios y se aparta del mal. Y todavía se aferra a su integridad, aunque tú {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} incitaste contra él para devorarlo por nada».
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo al Acusador: «¿Te has fijado en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo Job? No hay nadie como él en la tierra: es un hombre íntegro y recto, que teme a Dios y se aparta del mal. Todavía se mantiene firme en su integridad, aunque tú {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} provocaste contra él para destruirlo sin motivo».
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo al Acusador: «¿Has notado a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} siervo Job? No hay nadie en la tierra como él. Es íntegro y recto. Honra a Dios y se aleja del mal. Tú {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} empujaste a actuar contra él y a arruinarlo sin motivo, pero él sigue aferrado a su integridad».

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit au satan : « As-tu posé ton cœur sur {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} esclave Job ? Car il n’y a personne comme lui sur la terre, un homme intègre et droit, qui craint Dieu et se détourne du mal. Et il tient encore ferme son intégrité, alors que tu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pressais contre lui de l’engloutir pour rien. »
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à l’Accusateur : « As-tu prêté attention à {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur Job ? Il n’a pas son pareil sur terre : c’est un homme intègre et droit, qui craint Dieu et se détourne du mal. Il reste ferme dans son intégrité, bien que tu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} aies poussé contre lui pour le détruire sans raison. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à l’Accusateur : « As-tu vu {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} serviteur Job ? Personne sur la terre ne lui ressemble. Il est intègre et droit. Il honore Dieu et se tient loin du mal. Tu es venu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pousser à agir contre lui et à le ruiner sans raison, mais il reste attaché à son intégrité. »

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia yule satani, "Je, umeweka moyo wako juu ya mtumwa {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Ayubu? Kwa maana hakuna aliye kama yeye duniani, mtu mkamilifu na mnyofu, anayemcha Mungu na kujiepusha na uovu. Naye bado anashikilia ukamilifu wake, ingawa ulinichochea dhidi yake nimmeze bure."
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Mshtaki, "Je, umemfikiria mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Ayubu? Hakuna mtu kama yeye duniani: ni mtu mkamilifu na mnyofu, anayemcha Mungu na kujiepusha na uovu. Bado anashikilia kwa uthabiti ukamilifu wake, ingawa ulinichochea dhidi yake ili nimwangamize bila sababu."
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Mshtaki, "Je, umemwona mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} Ayubu? Hakuna mtu duniani aliye kama yeye. Yeye ni mkamilifu na mnyofu. Anamheshimu Mungu na kukaa mbali na uovu. Ulinishawishi nimshambulie na kumwangamiza bila sababu, lakini bado anashikilia ukamilifu wake."

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với kẻ sa-tan: "Ngươi có để lòng đến nô lệ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Gióp không? Vì trên đất không có ai như người, một người trọn vẹn và ngay thẳng, kính sợ Đức Chúa Trời và lánh xa điều ác. Người vẫn còn giữ vững sự trọn vẹn của mình, dù ngươi đã xúi giục {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chống lại người để nuốt người đi vô cớ."
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Kẻ Tố Cáo: "Ngươi có lưu tâm đến đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Gióp chăng? Trên đất chẳng có ai bằng người: một người trọn vẹn và ngay thẳng, kính sợ Đức Chúa Trời và lánh xa điều ác. Người vẫn bám chặt lấy sự trọn vẹn của mình, dù ngươi đã khích {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chống lại người để hủy diệt người vô cớ."
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Kẻ Tố Cáo: "Ngươi có thấy đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là Gióp không? Trên đất không ai giống như người. Người trọn vẹn và ngay thẳng. Người tôn kính Đức Chúa Trời và tránh xa điều ác. Ngươi đã giục {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ra tay hại người và hủy hoại người vô cớ, nhưng người vẫn giữ vững sự trọn vẹn của mình."

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그 사탄에게 말씀하셨다. "너는 내 종 욥에게 네 마음을 두었느냐? 땅 위에 그와 같은 자가 없으니, 흠 없고 정직하며, 하나님을 경외하고 악에서 떠난 사람이다. 그는 아직도 자기의 온전함을 굳게 붙들고 있다. 네가 나를 부추겨 까닭 없이 그를 삼키게 하였는데도 말이다."
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 고발자에게 말씀하셨다. "너는 내 종 욥을 눈여겨보았느냐? 땅 위에 그만한 사람이 없다. 그는 흠 없고 정직하며, 하나님을 경외하고 악에서 떠난 사람이다. 네가 나를 부추겨 아무 까닭 없이 그를 망하게 했는데도, 그는 여전히 자기의 온전함을 굳게 지키고 있다."
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 고발자에게 말씀하셨다. "너는 내 종 욥을 보았느냐? 세상에 그런 사람은 없다. 그는 흠 없고 정직하다. 그는 하나님을 두려운 마음으로 섬기고 악한 일을 멀리한다. 너는 나를 졸라 아무 이유 없이 그를 치고 망하게 했다. 그래도 그는 여전히 온전함을 지키고 있다."

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse ao Satanás: "Puseste o teu coração sobre o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} escravo Jó? Porque não há ninguém como ele na terra, homem íntegro e reto, que teme a Deus e se desvia do mal. E ele ainda se mantém firme na sua integridade, embora tu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} tenhas incitado contra ele para tragá-lo sem motivo."
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} disse ao acusador: "Prestaste atenção no {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo Jó? Não há ninguém como ele na terra: um homem íntegro e reto, que teme a Deus e se desvia do mal. Ele continua firme na sua integridade, mesmo que tu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} tenhas instigado contra ele para destruí-lo sem motivo."
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} disse ao acusador: "Reparaste no {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} servo Jó? Não há ninguém na terra como ele. Ele é íntegro e reto. Honra a Deus e se mantém longe do mal. Tu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} levaste a agir contra ele e a arruiná-lo sem motivo, mas ele continua firme na sua integridade."

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም ሰይጣኑን እንዲህ አለው፦ «ልብህን በባሪያዬ በኢዮብ ላይ አድርገሃልን? እንደ እርሱ ያለ በምድር ላይ የለምና፤ ነቀፋ የሌለበትና ቅን፣ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራና ከክፉ የሚርቅ ሰው ነው። አሁንም ፍጹምነቱን አጥብቆ እንደ ያዘ ነው፤ አንተ ግን ያለ ምክንያት እንድውጠው በእርሱ ላይ አነሣሣኸኝ።»
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከሳሹን እንዲህ አለው፦ «አገልጋዬን ኢዮብን አስተውለኸዋል? በምድር ላይ እንደ እርሱ ያለ ማንም የለም፤ ነቀፋ የሌለበትና ቅን፣ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራና ከክፉ የሚርቅ ሰው ነው። ያለ ምክንያት እንዳጠፋው በእርሱ ላይ ብታነሣሣኝም፣ እርሱ አሁንም ንጹሕ አቋሙን አጥብቆ ይዟል።»
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከሳሹን እንዲህ አለው፦ «አገልጋዬን ኢዮብን አየኸውን? በምድር ላይ እንደ እርሱ ያለ ማንም የለም። ነቀፋ የሌለበትና ቅን ሰው ነው። እግዚአብሔርን ያከብራል፣ ከክፉ ነገርም ይርቃል። አንተ ያለ ምክንያት በእርሱ ላይ እንድነሣና እንዳጠፋው ገፋፋኸኝ፤ እርሱ ግን አሁንም ንጹሕ አቋሙን እንደ ጠበቀ ነው።»

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने शैतान से कहा, "क्या तुमने मेरे दास अय्यूब पर अपना मन लगाया है? क्योंकि पृथ्वी पर उसके समान कोई नहीं, खरा और सीधा पुरुष, जो परमेश्वर का भय मानता और बुराई से दूर रहता है। और वह अब तक अपनी खराई को थामे हुए है, यद्यपि तुमने मुझे उसके विरुद्ध उकसाया कि उसे यों ही निगल जाऊँ।"
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने दोष लगानेवाले से कहा, "क्या तुमने मेरे दास अय्यूब पर ध्यान दिया है? पृथ्वी पर उसके जैसा कोई नहीं: वह खरा और सीधा पुरुष है, जो परमेश्वर का भय मानता और बुराई से दूर रहता है। वह अब भी अपनी खराई को दृढ़ता से थामे हुए है, यद्यपि तुमने मुझे उसके विरुद्ध भड़काया कि बिना कारण उसका नाश करूँ।"
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने दोष लगानेवाले से कहा, "क्या तुमने मेरे दास अय्यूब को देखा? पृथ्वी पर उसके जैसा कोई नहीं है। वह खरा और सीधा है। वह परमेश्वर का आदर करता है और बुराई से दूर रहता है। तुमने मुझे उकसाया कि मैं बिना कारण उसके विरुद्ध काम करूँ और उसे बरबाद कर दूँ, फिर भी वह अपनी खराई पर टिका हुआ है।"

ru.L: И сказал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сатане: «Обратил ли ты сердце твоё на раба {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} Иова? Ведь нет такого, как он, на земле: человек непорочный и праведный, боящийся Бога и удаляющийся от зла. И он всё ещё крепко держится своей непорочности, хотя ты подстрекнул {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} против него, чтобы погубить его без причины.»

ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал Обвинителю: «Ты заметил раба {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} Иова? Нет на земле никого, кто был бы похож на него. Он непорочен и праведен. decisions.choice: holds fast to his integrity: keeps his wholeness of heart toward God
decisions.reason: "Integrity" is the noun of the word "blameless" (1:1): wholeness, a life all of one piece. The phrase returns from his wife (2:9) and from Job himself: "till I die I will not put away my integrity from me" (27:5; also 31:6).

decisions.choice: for nothing: without cause
decisions.reason: This is the word the satan used in 1:9 ("Does Job fear God for nothing?"). The LORD turns it back on him: Job's devotion has proved to be "for nothing", not bought, while his ruin has been "for nothing", without any cause in Job.

decisions.choice: you incited me against him: the LORD speaks of the disaster as his own act
decisions.reason: The verb means to stir up, urge or entice someone to act (1 Samuel 26:19; 2 Samuel 24:1; 1 Kings 21:25). The LORD does not say the satan acted alone; he speaks of himself as having been moved against Job, just as Job said "the LORD has taken" (1:21). The text does not soften this, and the book does not explain it.

decisions.choice: to swallow him up: to destroy him
decisions.reason: "Swallow" is a common picture for destroying completely (2 Samuel 20:19-20; Lamentations 2:2, 5).

decisions.choice: slave (Literal); servant (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 1:8.

decisions.choice: the two clauses reversed (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable tells first what the Accuser did and then that Job still holds on, which makes the contrast plain in two short sentences.

decisions.choice: integrity (tummah, 2:3, 2:9; also tom, 4:6): L "ፍጹምነት" (wholeness); B, R "ንጹሕ አቋም" (integrity, an upright stand). The formula keeps the wording of 1:8.
decisions.reason: The noun belongs with "blameless" (1:1): what is whole and all of one piece. Literal keeps the root sense with "ፍጹምነት"; Balanced and Readable use the current word for a person's integrity, "ንጹሕ አቋም", which does not suggest sinlessness. "ቅን" already renders "upright" and "ታማኝነት" faithfulness, so neither is reused.

decisions.choice: "खराई" (integrity)
decisions.reason: "खराई" is the noun of "खरा" (blameless, 1:1), so the link between Job's character and his integrity stays visible in Hindi at every level, as the Hebrew word and the adjective share a root. The same word returns in 2:9 on his wife's lips.

decisions.choice: непорочность (L, B); остаётся непорочным (R)
decisions.reason: "Integrity" is the noun of the word translated "blameless" in 1:1 and 2:3 (m1), so Russian uses "непорочность", the noun of "непорочен", and Readable "остаётся непорочным", to keep the link the English makes with "integrity" at every level.

decisions.choice: погубить (L); уничтожить (B); разорить (R)
decisions.reason: "To swallow him up" means to destroy him (m4); Russian "поглотить" would read as a literal image, so Literal says "погубить".

decisions.choice: skin for skin: a saying about exchange, that a person will give anything to save himself
decisions.reason: This proverb appears only here and its exact picture is not known. It may come from trade, one skin or hide given in exchange for another, meaning a person will pay any price for what matters to him. Some take it to mean that a person will give up the skin of others, even his children's, to save his own. Either way the second half explains it: a man will give everything he has for his life. The satan claims Job has so far lost only what is outside him.

decisions.choice: all that a man has he will give for his life: anyone, not a particular man
decisions.reason: "A man" here is anyone; the satan states a general rule about human beings. "Life" is the person's own living self, which the LORD later tells the satan to spare (2:6).

decisions.choice: gender span for the general "a man"
decisions.reason: The saying is about people in general, so the default is inclusive, with "a man" as the alternative.

decisions.choice: save their own skin (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable uses the English idiom "to save one's own skin", which gives the sense of the proverb without its unfamiliar picture. The speech continues into the next verse, so the quotation is closed there.

decisions.choice: "人" with no gender span where the English has one for the general "a man".
decisions.reason: Japanese "人" already includes men and women (style §7a).

source.text: אוּלָם֙ שְֽׁלַֽח־נָ֣א יָֽדְךָ֔ וְגַ֥ע אֶל־עַצְמ֖וֹ וְאֶל־בְּשָׂר֑וֹ אִם־לֹ֥א אֶל־פָּנֶ֖יךָ יְבָרֲכֶֽךָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: But stretch out, please, your hand and touch to his bone and to his flesh; if not to your face he will bless you.

en.L: But stretch out {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand, please, and touch his bone and his flesh, [and see] if he will not curse {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face!"
en.B: But stretch out {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand and strike his bone and his flesh, and he will surely curse {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face."
en.R: But reach out and hurt his body. Then he will curse {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face!"

es.L: Pero extiende ahora {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano y toca sus huesos y su carne, [y verás] si no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} maldice en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} cara».
es.B: Pero extiende {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano y golpea sus huesos y su carne, y de seguro {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} maldecirá en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} cara».
es.R: Pero extiende la mano y hazle daño en su cuerpo. ¡Entonces {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} maldecirá en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} cara!».

fr.L: Mais étends donc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main et touche à ses os et à sa chair, [et tu verras] s’il ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} maudit pas à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face ! »
fr.B: Mais étends {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main et frappe-le dans ses os et dans sa chair : il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} maudira sûrement en face. »
fr.R: Mais avance la main et fais-lui du mal dans son corps. Alors il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} maudira en face ! »

sw.L: Lakini nyoosha basi mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, uguse mfupa wake na nyama yake, [uone] kama hatakulaani mbele ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}!"
sw.B: Lakini nyoosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} upige mifupa yake na mwili wake, naye hakika atakulaani ana kwa ana."
sw.R: Lakini nyoosha mkono uudhuru mwili wake. Hapo ndipo atakulaani waziwazi!"

vi.L: Nhưng xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hãy giơ tay ra và đụng đến xương thịt người, [xem] người có nguyền rủa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngay trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không!"
vi.B: Nhưng xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hãy giơ tay ra đánh vào xương thịt người, chắc chắn người sẽ nguyền rủa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngay trước mặt."
vi.R: Nhưng xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hãy ra tay làm hại thân thể người. Rồi người sẽ nguyền rủa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngay trước mặt!"

ko.L: 그러나 부디 주님의 손을 펴서 그의 뼈와 그의 살을 건드려 보십시오. 그가 주님 앞에서 대놓고 주님을 저주하지 않나 [보십시오]!"
ko.B: 그러나 주님께서 손을 펴서 그의 뼈와 살을 치시면, 그는 틀림없이 주님 앞에서 대놓고 주님을 저주할 것입니다."
ko.R: 그러나 주님께서 손을 뻗어 그의 몸을 쳐 보십시오. 그러면 그는 주님 앞에서 대놓고 주님을 저주할 것입니다!"

pt.L: Mas estende, por favor, a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} mão e toca no seu osso e na sua carne, [e verás] se ele não {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} amaldiçoa na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} cara!"
pt.B: Mas estende a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} mão e fere os ossos e a carne dele, e com certeza ele {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} amaldiçoará na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} cara."
pt.R: Mas estende a mão e fere o corpo dele. Então ele vai {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} amaldiçoar na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} cara!"

am.L: ነገር ግን እባክህ እጅህን ዘርጋ፤ አጥንቱንና ሥጋውንም ንካ፤ በፊትህ ባይረግምህ [እይ]!»
am.B: ነገር ግን እጅህን ዘርግተህ አጥንቱንና ሥጋውን ብትመታ፣ በእርግጥ በፊትህ ይሰድብሃል።»
am.R: ነገር ግን እጅህን ዘርግተህ ሰውነቱን ጉዳው፤ ያን ጊዜ በፊትህ ይሰድብሃል!»

hi.L: परन्तु अपना हाथ बढ़ा, और उसकी हड्डियों और उसके मांस को छू, [और देख] कि वह तेरे मुँह पर तेरी निंदा करता है कि नहीं!"
hi.B: पर अपना हाथ बढ़ाकर उसकी हड्डियों और उसके मांस पर प्रहार कर, तो वह निश्चय तेरे मुँह पर तेरी निंदा करेगा।"
hi.R: पर तू हाथ बढ़ाकर उसके शरीर को चोट पहुँचा। फिर वह तेरे मुँह पर तेरी निंदा करेगा!"

ru.L: Но протяни {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} руку и коснись кости его и плоти его — [и увидишь,] не проклянёт ли он {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} в лицо!»
ru.B: Но протяни {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} руку и порази его кости и плоть, и он непременно проклянёт {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} в лицо.»
ru.R: Но протяни руку и порази его тело. Тогда он проклянёт {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} прямо в лицо!»

ja.L: しかし、どうか、あなたの手を伸ばして、彼の骨と肉に触れてみてください。[そうすれば、]彼があなたの顔に向かってあなたを呪わないはずがありません！」
ja.B: しかし、手を伸ばして、彼の骨と肉を打ってみてください。そうすれば、彼は必ず、面と向かってあなたを呪うでしょう。」
ja.R: でも、手を伸ばして、ヨブの体を痛めつけてみてください。そうすれば、ヨブはきっと面と向かって、あなたをのろうでしょう！」

uk.L: Але простягни, прошу, свою руку й торкнися його кості та його тіла, — [і побач], чи не прокляне він {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} в обличчя!»
uk.B: Але простягни руку й удар по його кістках і тілу, і він напевно прокляне {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} в обличчя».
uk.R: Але простягни руку й завдай болю його тілу. Тоді він прокляне {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} в обличчя!»

decisions.choice: his bone and his flesh: his body, his very self
decisions.reason: Bone and flesh together mean the whole body, the person himself (Genesis 2:23; 29:14). Having lost what he owned, Job is now to be struck in his own body.

decisions.choice: if he will not curse you: an oath, with "bless" meaning "curse"
decisions.reason: As in 1:11: "if not" makes a strong claim (he surely will), and the verb for "bless" stands in place of "curse" (see 1:5).

decisions.choice: reach out and hurt his body (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says what "stretch out your hand and touch his bone and his flesh" means.

source.text: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־הַשָּׂטָ֖ן הִנּ֣וֹ בְיָדֶ֑ךָ אַ֖ךְ אֶת־נַפְשׁ֥וֹ שְׁמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And said YHWH to the satan, see, he [is] in your hand; only his life preserve.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to the satan, "Look, he is in your hand; only preserve his life."
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to the Accuser, "Very well, he is in your power. Only spare his life."
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} said to the Accuser, "All right. You may do what you want to him. But you must not kill him."

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo al satán: «Mira, él está en tu mano; solo guarda su vida».
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo al Acusador: «Está bien, él está en tu poder. Solo respeta su vida».
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dijo al Acusador: «De acuerdo. Puedes hacer con él lo que quieras. Pero no lo mates».

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit au satan : « Voici, il est dans ta main ; seulement, garde sa vie. »
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit à l’Accusateur : « Soit ! Il est en ton pouvoir. Seulement, épargne sa vie. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit à l’Accusateur : « D’accord. Tu peux faire de lui ce que tu veux. Mais tu ne dois pas le tuer. »

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia yule satani, "Tazama, yeye yumo mkononi mwako; ila uhai wake uuhifadhi."
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Mshtaki, "Haya, yuko katika uwezo wako. Ila usiuguse uhai wake."
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Mshtaki, "Sawa. Unaweza kumfanya lolote unalotaka. Lakini usimwue."

vi.L: Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với kẻ sa-tan: "Kìa, người ở trong tay ngươi; chỉ hãy giữ lấy mạng sống người."
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Kẻ Tố Cáo: "Được, người ở trong quyền ngươi. Chỉ phải để cho người sống."
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Kẻ Tố Cáo: "Được thôi. Ngươi muốn làm gì người cũng được. Nhưng ngươi không được giết người."

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그 사탄에게 말씀하셨다. "보아라, 그가 네 손에 있다. 다만 그의 목숨은 지켜라."
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 고발자에게 말씀하셨다. "좋다. 그를 네 권한에 맡긴다. 다만 그의 목숨만은 살려 두어라."
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 고발자에게 말씀하셨다. "좋다. 그를 네가 원하는 대로 해도 된다. 그러나 그를 죽여서는 안 된다."

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse ao Satanás: "Eis que ele [está] na tua mão; somente guarda a vida dele."
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} disse ao acusador: "Pois bem, ele está em teu poder. Somente poupa a vida dele."
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} disse ao acusador: "Está bem. Podes fazer o que quiseres com ele. Mas não podes matá-lo."

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}ም ሰይጣኑን፦ «እነሆ፣ እርሱ በእጅህ ነው፤ ብቻ ነፍሱን ጠብቅ» አለው።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከሳሹን፦ «መልካም፣ እርሱ በሥልጣንህ ሥር ነው፤ ሕይወቱን ብቻ ተውለት» አለው።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ከሳሹን፦ «ይሁን፤ በእርሱ ላይ የፈለግኸውን ማድረግ ትችላለህ፤ ነገር ግን መግደል የለብህም» አለው።

hi.L: और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने शैतान से कहा, "देखो, वह तुम्हारे हाथ में है; केवल उसके प्राण को सुरक्षित रखना।"
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने दोष लगानेवाले से कहा, "अच्छा, वह तुम्हारे अधिकार में है। केवल उसका प्राण छोड़ देना।"
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने दोष लगानेवाले से कहा, "ठीक है। उसके साथ तुम जो चाहो कर सकते हो। पर उसे मार न डालना।"

ru.L: И сказал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сатане: «Вот, он в руке твоей; только жизнь его сохрани.»
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал Обвинителю: «Хорошо, он в твоей власти. Только жизнь его пощади.»
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сказал Обвинителю: «Ладно. Можешь делать с ним что хочешь. Но убивать его нельзя.»

ja.L: そして{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はサタンに言われた。「見なさい、彼はおまえの手の中にある。ただ、彼の命だけは守りなさい。」
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告発する者に言われた。「よろしい。彼をおまえの手にゆだねる。ただし、命だけは取ってはならない。」
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告発する者に言われました。「いいだろう。ヨブをおまえの好きにしてよい。しかし、命を奪ってはいけない。」

uk.L: І сказав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сатані: «Ось він у твоїй руці; тільки збережи його життя».
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав Обвинувачеві: «Добре, він у твоїй владі. Тільки пощади його життя».
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} сказав Обвинувачеві: «Гаразд. Можеш робити з ним, що хочеш. Але не вбивай його».

decisions.choice: only preserve his life: a new limit, still set by the LORD
decisions.reason: As in 1:12, the LORD grants the satan power but fixes a boundary. Before, it was Job's person; now it is his life. Job must live through the test.

decisions.choice: in your hand: in your power
decisions.reason: As in 1:12.

decisions.choice: preserve (Literal); spare (Balanced); must not kill him (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb means to keep or guard; Balanced and Readable say what guarding his life means here.

source.text: וַיֵּצֵא֙ הַשָּׂטָ֔ן מֵאֵ֖ת פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּ֤ךְ אֶת־אִיּוֹב֙ בִּשְׁחִ֣ין רָ֔ע מִכַּ֥ף רַגְל֖וֹ וְעַ֥ד קָדְקֳדֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And went out the satan from with [the] face of YHWH, and struck Job with sores bad from [the] sole of his foot and to the crown of his head.

en.L: And the satan went out from the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and struck Job with bad sores from the sole of his foot to the crown of his head.
en.B: So the Accuser went out from the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and struck Job with painful sores from the soles of his feet to the top of his head.
en.R: So the Accuser left the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and made painful sores break out all over Job's body, from the bottoms of his feet to the top of his head.

es.L: Y el satán salió de delante de la presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} e hirió a Job con llagas malas desde la planta de su pie hasta la coronilla de su cabeza.
es.B: Así que el Acusador salió de la presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} e hirió a Job con llagas dolorosas desde la planta de los pies hasta la cabeza.
es.R: Así que el Acusador se retiró de la presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} e hizo que le salieran a Job llagas dolorosas por todo el cuerpo, desde la planta de los pies hasta la cabeza.

fr.L: Et le satan sortit de devant la face {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et il frappa Job de mauvais ulcères, de la plante de son pied jusqu’au sommet de son crâne.
fr.B: L’Accusateur se retira donc de la présence {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et frappa Job de plaies douloureuses, de la plante des pieds jusqu’au haut de la tête.
fr.R: L’Accusateur a donc quitté la présence {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et il a fait sortir des plaies douloureuses sur tout le corps de Job, du dessous des pieds jusqu’au haut de la tête.

sw.L: Naye yule satani akatoka mbele ya uso wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akampiga Ayubu kwa vidonda vibaya kuanzia nyayo za mguu wake mpaka kilele cha kichwa chake.
sw.B: Basi Mshtaki akaondoka mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akampiga Ayubu kwa vidonda vyenye maumivu kuanzia nyayo za miguu hadi utosini.
sw.R: Basi Mshtaki akaondoka mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akamletea Ayubu vidonda vyenye maumivu mwili mzima, kuanzia chini ya nyayo zake hadi juu ya kichwa chake.

vi.L: Và kẻ sa-tan đi ra khỏi trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và giáng cho Gióp những ung nhọt độc từ lòng bàn chân người cho đến đỉnh đầu người.
vi.B: Vậy Kẻ Tố Cáo lui ra khỏi trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và giáng cho Gióp những ung nhọt đau đớn từ lòng bàn chân cho đến đỉnh đầu.
vi.R: Vậy Kẻ Tố Cáo rời khỏi trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và làm cho Gióp nổi ung nhọt đau đớn khắp người, từ lòng bàn chân đến tận đỉnh đầu.

ko.L: 그리고 그 사탄이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 얼굴 앞에서 나가서, 욥의 발바닥부터 머리 꼭대기까지 나쁜 종기로 욥을 쳤다.
ko.B: 그래서 고발자는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 물러가, 욥의 발바닥에서 머리끝까지 고통스러운 종기가 돋게 했다.
ko.R: 그래서 고발자는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 떠나가 욥의 온몸에, 발바닥부터 머리 꼭대기까지 아픈 종기가 생기게 했다.

pt.L: E o Satanás saiu da presença {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e feriu Jó com úlceras malignas, desde a planta do seu pé até o alto da sua cabeça.
pt.B: Então o acusador saiu da presença {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e feriu Jó com úlceras doloridas, desde a planta dos pés até o alto da cabeça.
pt.R: Então o acusador se retirou da presença {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e fez aparecer feridas doloridas no corpo inteiro de Jó, desde a sola dos pés até o alto da cabeça.

am.L: ሰይጣኑም {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ፊት ወጣ፤ ኢዮብንም ከእግሩ ጫማ እስከ ራሱ አናት ድረስ በክፉ ቁስል መታው።
am.B: ስለዚህ ከሳሹ {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ፊት ወጥቶ ኢዮብን ከእግሩ ጫማ እስከ ራሱ አናት ድረስ በሚያሠቃይ ቁስል መታው።
am.R: ስለዚህ ከሳሹ {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ፊት ሄደ፤ ከእግሩ ጫማ እስከ ራሱ ጫፍ ድረስ በኢዮብ ሰውነት ሁሉ ላይ የሚያሠቃይ ቁስል አወጣበት።

hi.L: और शैतान {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सामने से निकल गया, और उसने अय्यूब को पाँव के तलवे से लेकर सिर की चोटी तक बुरे फोड़ों से मारा।
hi.B: तब दोष लगानेवाला {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सामने से चला गया, और उसने अय्यूब को पाँवों के तलवों से लेकर सिर तक दर्दनाक फोड़ों से पीड़ित किया।
hi.R: तब दोष लगानेवाला {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सामने से चला गया, और उसने अय्यूब के सारे शरीर पर, पाँवों के तलवों से लेकर सिर तक, दर्दनाक फोड़े निकाल दिए।

ru.L: И вышел сатана от лица {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и поразил Иова злыми нарывами от подошвы ноги его до темени его.
ru.B: И Обвинитель ушёл от {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и поразил Иова мучительными нарывами от подошв ног до макушки.
ru.R: И Обвинитель ушёл от {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и покрыл всё тело Иова мучительными нарывами, от пяток до макушки.

ja.L: そしてサタンは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前から出て行き、ヨブを打って、足の裏から頭のてっぺんまで、ひどい腫れ物で覆った。
ja.B: そこで告発する者は{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前から出て行き、ヨブを打って、足の裏から頭のてっぺんまで、ひどい腫れ物で覆った。
ja.R: そこで、告発する者は{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前から出て行きました。そして、ヨブの足の裏から頭のてっぺんまで、体じゅうに痛いできものができるようにしました。

uk.L: І вийшов сатана з-перед обличчя {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОГО|Ягве}} і вразив Йова лихими виразками від підошви його ноги аж до його тімʼя.
uk.B: Тож Обвинувач пішов з-перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОГО|Ягве}} обличчя й уразив Йова болючими виразками від підошов до верху голови.
uk.R: Тож Обвинувач пішов з-перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}} і вкрив усе тіло Йова болючими виразками, від підошов ніг до верху голови.

decisions.choice: bad sores: inflamed boils on the skin
decisions.reason: The word names boils or inflamed sores (Exodus 9:9-11; Leviticus 13:18-20; 2 Kings 20:7). The disease cannot be identified. Job later describes its effects: itching, crusted and broken skin, sleeplessness and wasting (2:8; 7:4-5; 19:20; 30:17, 30).

decisions.choice: from the sole of his foot to the crown of his head: the words of the covenant curse
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 28:35 threatens the disobedient with "bad sores ... from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head", the same words. Anyone who knew that passage would take Job's disease as a sign of God's judgment, as his friends will; the reader knows that Job is blameless (2:3).

decisions.choice: made painful sores break out all over Job's body (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable adds "all over Job's body" to make the extent plain before the phrase that spells it out.

decisions.choice: "úlceras malignas" (L), "úlceras doloridas" (B), "feridas doloridas" (R); "desde a planta do pé até o alto da cabeça"
decisions.reason: The words are those of the covenant curse (m2), so each level uses the wording of the Portuguese of Deuteronomy 28:35 at the same level, and a reader who knows it hears the echo.

decisions.choice: злые нарывы (L); мучительные нарывы (B, R)
decisions.reason: The sores are inflamed boils on the skin (m1); "нарывы" names them plainly. "Проказа" would name a particular disease the Hebrew does not.

fr.B: Job prit un débris de poterie pour se gratter, tandis qu’il était assis dans la cendre.
fr.R: Job s’est assis dans la cendre. Il a pris un morceau de pot cassé et s’en est servi pour gratter ses plaies.

sw.L: Naye akajitwalia kigae ili ajikune nacho, naye alikuwa ameketi katikati ya majivu.
sw.B: Ayubu akachukua kipande cha chungu kilichovunjika ili ajikune nacho alipokuwa ameketi katikati ya majivu.
sw.R: Ayubu aliketi chini kwenye majivu. Akachukua kipande cha chungu kilichovunjika, akakitumia kujikuna vidonda vyake.

vi.B: Gióp lấy một mảnh gốm vỡ để gãi mình trong khi ngồi giữa tro.
vi.R: Gióp ngồi trong đống tro. Ông lấy một mảnh nồi vỡ để gãi các chỗ ung nhọt.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 자기 몸을 긁으려고 질그릇 조각 하나를 집어 들었고, 잿더미 가운데 앉아 있었다.

ko.R: 욥은 잿더미에 주저앉았다. 그리고 깨진 그릇 조각을 집어 들고 종기 난 데를 긁었다.

pt.B: Jó pegou um caco de cerâmica para se coçar, enquanto estava sentado no meio das cinzas.
pt.R: Jó se sentou nas cinzas. Pegou um pedaço de um pote quebrado e o usou para coçar as feridas.

am.L: እርሱም ራሱን የሚፍቅበት ገል ለራሱ ወሰደ፤ በአመድም መካከል ተቀምጦ ነበር።
am.B: ኢዮብም በአመድ መካከል ተቀምጦ ሳለ ሰውነቱን የሚፍቅበት የተሰበረ የሸክላ ገል ወሰደ።
am.R: ኢዮብ በአመድ ላይ ተቀመጠ። የተሰበረ የሸክላ ዕቃ ቁራጭ አንሥቶ ቁስሎቹን ያክበት ነበር።

hi.L: और उसने अपने लिए एक ठीकरा लिया कि उससे अपने आप को खुजलाए, और वह राख के बीच बैठा हुआ था।
hi.B: अय्यूब राख के बीच बैठा था, और उसने अपने को खुजलाने के लिए मिट्टी के टूटे बर्तन का एक टुकड़ा ले लिया।
hi.R: अय्यूब राख में बैठ गया। उसने एक टूटे घड़े का टुकड़ा लिया और उससे अपने फोड़ों को खुजलाने लगा।

ru.L: И взял он себе черепок, чтобы скоблить себя им, и сидел он среди пепла.
ru.B: Иов взял черепок, чтобы соскабливать им гной, и сидел среди пепла.
ru.R: Иов сел в пепел. Он взял осколок разбитого горшка и чесал им свои нарывы.

ja.L: そして彼は土器のかけらを取って、それで自分の体をかいた。彼は灰の中に座っていた。
ja.B: ヨブは灰の中に座り、土器のかけらを取って、それで体をかきむしった。
ja.R: ヨブは灰の中に座りました。そして、割れたつぼのかけらで、できものをかきました。

uk.L: І він узяв собі черепок, щоб шкрябати себе ним, а він сидів серед попелу.
uk.B: Йов узяв черепок, щоб шкрябати себе, сидячи серед попелу.
uk.R: Йов сів у попіл. Він узяв уламок розбитого горщика й шкрябав ним свої виразки.

decisions.choice: sitting among the ashes: a sign of grief and humiliation, perhaps on the town's ash heap
decisions.reason: Sitting in ashes or dust was a sign of mourning and deep humiliation (Jonah 3:6; Ezekiel 27:30; Job 42:6). The place may have been the heap outside the town where ashes and refuse were dumped (compare 1 Samuel 2:8; Psalm 113:7); the old Greek translation says Job sat "on the dung heap outside the city". The Hebrew says only "among the ashes".

decisions.choice: a potsherd to scrape himself: a broken piece of pottery, used against the itching sores
decisions.reason: Broken pottery lay everywhere in an ancient town. Job uses a shard to scrape his inflamed skin, a picture of pain and of how far the greatest man of the East has fallen (1:3).

decisions.choice: the sitting told first (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable puts Job's sitting in the ashes first and makes it a separate sentence, because the Hebrew clause describes where he already was.

decisions.choice: the sitting told first (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The English Balanced joins the clauses with "as he sat"; Hindi says first where he was sitting and then what he took, which reads more naturally in one sentence. Readable does the same in two sentences, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: соскабливать им гной (B)
decisions.reason: Balanced says what was scraped, since "скоблить себя" alone is unclear in Russian; the potsherd was used against the itching sores (m2).
